"""Hand-crafted semantic cases, checked against the brute force reference."""
import sys, json, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import analyze as A
import ref as R

def snap(sid, bounds, controller, tol, obs):
    return {'id': sid, 'bounds': bounds, 'controller': controller, 'tolerance': tol,
            'observations': obs}

def obs(oid, metric, target, lo, hi, dom=None):
    return {'id': oid, 'metric': metric, 'target': target, 'lower': lo, 'upper': hi, 'domain': dom}

CASES = []

# A: overlapping routes, fractional loads
CASES.append({'id': 'overlap', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B', 'C'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100},
              {'id': 'bc', 'source': 'B', 'target': 'C', 'capacity': 100},
              {'id': 'ac', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'C', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AC', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'C', 'routes': [
        {'edges': ['ab', 'bc'], 'weight': 3}, {'edges': ['ac'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': [], 'max_faults': 0,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 20]], [0], 0, [obs('o1', 'link', 'ab', 3, 3)])]})

# B: parallel edges with tight capacities
CASES.append({'id': 'parallel', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab1', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 2},
              {'id': 'ab2', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 3}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AB', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'routes': [
        {'edges': ['ab1'], 'weight': 1}, {'edges': ['ab2'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': [], 'max_faults': 0,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 10]], [0], 0, [])]})

# C: domain shared across snapshots, two simultaneous faults
CASES.append({'id': 'correlated', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B', 'C'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100},
              {'id': 'bc', 'source': 'B', 'target': 'C', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AC', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'C',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['ab', 'bc'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': ['d1', 'd2'], 'max_faults': 2,
    'snapshots': [
        snap('s1', [[0, 10]], [0], 0, [obs('a', 'link', 'ab', 5, 5, 'd1'),
                                       obs('b', 'link', 'bc', 2, 2, 'd2')]),
        snap('s2', [[0, 10]], [0], 0, [obs('c', 'link', 'ab', 7, 7, 'd2'),
                                       obs('d', 'link', 'bc', 1, 1, 'd1')])]})

# D: zero traffic, zero capacity
CASES.append({'id': 'zerotraffic', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 0}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AB', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['ab'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': ['d'], 'max_faults': 1,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 0]], [0], 0, [obs('o', 'link', 'ab', 0, 0, None)])]})

# E: unobserved domain can never be faulty
CASES.append({'id': 'unused-domain', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AB', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['ab'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': ['ghost'], 'max_faults': 1,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 5]], [2], 0, [obs('o', 'demand', 'AB', 2, 2, None)])]})

# F: contradictory trusted observation across metrics
CASES.append({'id': 'trust-conflict', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AB', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['ab'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': [], 'max_faults': 0,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 10]], [0], 0,
                       [obs('o1', 'demand', 'AB', 4, 4),
                        obs('o2', 'ingress', 'A', 5, 5)])]})

# G: domain forced by an impossible observation
CASES.append({'id': 'forced-fault', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AB', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['ab'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': ['d'], 'max_faults': 1,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 5]], [2], 0, [obs('o', 'link', 'ab', 99, 100, 'd')])]})

# H: budget too small -> infeasible
CASES.append({'id': 'budget', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AB', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['ab'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': ['d1', 'd2'], 'max_faults': 1,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 5]], [2], 0, [obs('o1', 'link', 'ab', 99, 100, 'd1'),
                                               obs('o2', 'link', 'ab', 98, 99, 'd2')])]})

# I: controller verdicts with tolerance and zero commodities
CASES.append({'id': 'no-comm', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 10}],
    'commodities': [], 'domains': ['d'], 'max_faults': 0,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [], [], 0, [obs('o', 'link', 'ab', 0, 0),
                                        obs('p', 'egress', 'B', 0, 0, 'd')])]})

# J: fractional link bounds with wide ranges
CASES.append({'id': 'thirds', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100},
              {'id': 'ab2', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AB', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'routes': [
        {'edges': ['ab'], 'weight': 2}, {'edges': ['ab2'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': [], 'max_faults': 0,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 9]], [3], 1, [obs('o', 'link', 'ab', 0, 6)])]})

# K: weights 8 in a single route
CASES.append({'id': 'w8', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'e1', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100},
              {'id': 'e2', 'source': 'B', 'target': 'C', 'capacity': 100},
              {'id': 'e3', 'source': 'C', 'target': 'D', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AD', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'D',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['e1', 'e2', 'e3'], 'weight': 8}]}],
    'domains': [], 'max_faults': 0,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 3]], [1], 0, [obs('o', 'link', 'e2', 8, 8)])]})

# L: reversed id ordering / names
CASES.append({'id': 'z-case', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['Z9', 'A0'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'zz', 'source': 'Z9', 'target': 'A0', 'capacity': 7}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'c-1', 'source': 'Z9', 'target': 'A0',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['zz'], 'weight': 2}]}],
    'domains': ['D_x'], 'max_faults': 1,
    'snapshots': [snap('snap-1', [[1, 2]], [2], 2, [obs('o_1', 'link', 'zz', 2, 3, 'D_x')])]})

# M: ingress/egress with several commodities
CASES.append({'id': 'inout', 'version': 1, 'nodes': ['A', 'B', 'C'],
    'edges': [{'id': 'ab', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B', 'capacity': 100},
              {'id': 'bc', 'source': 'B', 'target': 'C', 'capacity': 100}],
    'commodities': [{'id': 'AB', 'source': 'A', 'target': 'B',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['ab'], 'weight': 1}]},
                    {'id': 'BC', 'source': 'B', 'target': 'C',
                     'routes': [{'edges': ['bc'], 'weight': 1}]}],
    'domains': [], 'max_faults': 0,
    'snapshots': [snap('s', [[0, 6], [0, 6]], [0, 0], 0,
                       [obs('i1', 'ingress', 'A', 2, 2), obs('i2', 'ingress', 'B', 3, 3),
                        obs('e1', 'egress', 'C', 3, 3), obs('e2', 'egress', 'B', 2, 2),
                        obs('l1', 'link', 'ab', 2, 2), obs('l2', 'link', 'bc', 3, 3)])]})

def main():
    fails = 0
    for req in CASES:
        inst = A._parse_request(req)
        mine = A.analyze(inst, req['id'])
        refres, stats = R.ref_analyze(inst)
        probs = []
        if mine['status'] != refres['status']:
            probs.append(('status', mine['status'], refres['status']))
        elif refres['status'] != 'infeasible':
            if mine['min_faults'] != refres['min_faults']:
                probs.append(('k', mine['min_faults'], refres['min_faults']))
            if set(mine['faults']['forced']) != set(refres['faults']['forced']):
                probs.append(('forced', mine['faults']['forced'], refres['faults']['forced']))
            if set(mine['faults']['possible']) != set(refres['faults']['possible']):
                probs.append(('possible', mine['faults']['possible'], refres['faults']['possible']))
            for s in range(len(inst['snapshots'])):
                if mine['snapshots'][s]['demands'] != refres['snapshots'][s]['demands']:
                    probs.append(('demands', mine['snapshots'][s]['demands'], refres['snapshots'][s]['demands']))
                if mine['snapshots'][s]['links'] != refres['snapshots'][s]['links']:
                    probs.append(('links', mine['snapshots'][s]['links'], refres['snapshots'][s]['links']))
                if mine['snapshots'][s]['verdict'] != refres['snapshots'][s]['verdict']:
                    probs.append(('verdict', mine['snapshots'][s]['verdict'], refres['snapshots'][s]['verdict']))
        print('%-14s %-11s k=%-3s %s' % (req['id'], mine['status'], mine.get('min_faults'),
              'OK' if not probs else 'PROBLEMS %s' % (probs,)))
        if probs:
            fails += 1
            print('   mine  :', json.dumps(mine))
            print('   ref   :', json.dumps(refres))
    print('fails', fails)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
PYEOF
